description: By AFGE “AFGE also has endorsed Peggy Flanagan for election to the U.S. Senate representing Minnesota and the following candidates for the U.S. House: Jake Johnson (CD-1), Matt Little (CD-2), and incumbent Reps. Kelly Morrison (CD-3), Betty McCollum (CD-4), and Ilhan Omar (CD-5).”

title: Largest Federal Employee Union Endorses Minnesota’s Trina Swanson for Election to U.S. House — Betty McCollum for Congress
